category_name_zh: 日常后端缺陷修复（容器化仓库）

dimensions.name: Issue Resolved (hidden FAIL_TO_PASS + PASS_TO_PASS tests, pass rate over trials)
dimensions.scoring_formula: pass_rate = trials resolved / trials; score = 100 * pass_rate snapped to the nearest tier

score_synthesis.formula: total_score = D1. A trial is resolved iff every FAIL_TO_PASS test passes (the fix works) and every PASS_TO_PASS test still passes (nothing regressed), exactly as in SWE-bench.
notes: Entries are selected for closeness to Rednote backend daily work (Django ORM, MySQL, JSONField, i18n, HTTP proxies), not for model discrimination; expect high resolve rates for strong models.
SWE-bench Verified is public since 2024 and the gold fixes are in upstream history: treat scores as a daily-work sanity check, not a contamination-free measurement.
Infrastructure failures are recorded per trial as infra_error and count as 0; rerun if infra_error appears.

verifier_contract.runs_in: the instance's official SWE-bench eval image (/testbed), after the agent finishes
steps: record `git diff <base_commit>` as the model patch (informational)
run the official eval.sh (swebench==4.1.0 make_test_spec): reset test files, apply the hidden test patch, run the test command
grade the combined stdout+stderr log on the host with swebench's get_eval_report
verifier_contract.output: {reward: 0|1 (= resolved), reason, checks: FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS per test, swebench_report, model_patch}
